strings.reminder_appointment: Hello. Reminder from your health worker: you have an appointment at the health centre on {date}. Please come and bring your medicines. Thank you.
strings.follow_up_after_visit: Hello, this is your health worker. How are you? Are you taking your medicine every day? If you have a blood pressure reading, please reply with it, for example 140/90.
strings.sms_check: Hello, this is your weekly check from your health worker. Please reply with your blood pressure if you have it (for example 140/90), if you took your medicine, and how you feel.
strings.report_received: Thank you. Your health worker has received your message.
strings.danger_signs_seek_care: Important: if you have face drooping, a weak arm, trouble speaking, a sudden very bad headache or loss of sight, go to the health centre now and call your health worker.
